statements.text: I do not want to see our land and water destroyed by data centers and AI coming into our region and draining our resources.
statements.venue: Yo Voto Por Mi Pueblo voter guide (quoted)

statements.text: I cannot go anywhere without Texans being really concerned about data centers coming into their community, taking up their water supply, and being a nuisance to them,

I support a temporary moratorium on new data centers until affected communities have been heard and enforceable protections are in place. [...] In Congress, I will oppose federal efforts to override stronger state or local protections.
statements.venue: SNAP Coalition Stance on Science candidate questionnaire

statements.text: Large new users, including data centers, should pay for the infrastructure their demand requires and reduce nonessential use during an emergency. Those costs should not quietly land on residential customers.
statements.venue: SNAP Coalition Stance on Science candidate questionnaire

statements.text: I have called for a moratorium on new data center construction until Congress enacts meaningful legislation to protect our water resources, electric grid and taxpayers. I am equally concerned about the enormous tax incentives being offered to these corporations in exchange for a very few jobs.
statements.venue: El Paso Matters candidate questionnaire, TX-23 general election
